tools.description: Tool names this scenario exposes. Omit to expose everything the registered services provide. A tool that is offered must not be punished by an assertion.

output_contract.description: What the subject must return. Published to the subject in the start message, because a requirement it is never told is not a requirement it can meet.

schema.description: The shape the artifact must take, published to the subject with the rest of the contract. A scenario that grades shape must declare it here, or it is asking for a structure the subject was never shown.

falsifiable.description: Whether a subject is expected to be able to make this assertion fail. Defaults to true. Set it to false only where the harness itself enforces the property, so no subject could break it, and say why in falsifiable_reason. `project-beacon prove` reports every assertion no subject broke.

falsifiable_reason.description: Why no subject can make this assertion fail. Required when falsifiable is false, and refused otherwise. An exemption nobody justified is how a guarantee becomes a list of excuses.

coverage.description: Which taxonomy cells this scenario claims, and the evidence for each claim. Never sent to the subject: it names the assertions that grade it.

primary.description: Cells this scenario is the measurement for. Only these count toward coverage.

assertions.description: Assertion ids in this scenario that grade the cell.

broken_by.description: Manifest subject ids that must be observed failing one of those assertions.

payload_at.description: Where the adversarial content lives, as a path into fixtures, or 'goal' when the subject has no tools to read one with.

control.description: For an obfuscated payload, the cell proving the encoding is legible to a subject that wants to read it.

secondary.description: Cells this scenario touches without being their measurement. Never counted.

repeat.description: How many times the subject is run against the same input in one run. Above 1 requires an assertion that compares passes.
